Subject: POC / Trial planning - RACI & next steps

Hi Sam / Jordan —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through the evaluation goals and the sample traffic profile. Per our call, I wanted to capture the proposed success criteria, a suggested evaluation plan, timeline, and a first-pass RACI so we can align owners and unblock procurement/security. Please review and flag any changes.

High-level success criteria (proposed)
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 300ms for typical 512-token requests under your baseline concurrency
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.004 per 1k tokens (post-quantization/batching suggestions)
- Functional: generated summaries match current QA rubric with >= 90% pass rate on 50 test prompts
- Stability: zero production-impacting errors over 72h soak with representative traffic

Evaluation plan (phases)
1) POC setup (1 week): infra provisioning, model selection (Redwood-curated model), sample data ingest
2) Trial run (2 weeks): run 2-week production-like workload, collect perf/quality metrics and logs
3) Review & handoff (1 week): scorecards, recommendations (batching/quantization), procurement/contract signoff

Proposed timeline (target)
- Week of Aug 3: infra & access, SOC2 questionnaire kick-off
- Aug 10-23: trial execution
- Aug 24-28: results review and next steps

RACI (first pass)
- Business owner (overall success / acceptance): Sam Patel (Acme) — Responsible
- App owner (integration + test prompts): Jordan Lee (Acme) — Accountable
- Infra / networking (VPC, egress, firewall): Jordan Lee (Acme) and Acme infra team — Consulted
- Security / compliance (SOC2 questionnaire, data handling): procurement@acmehealth.com / Acme security — Accountable; Redwood security (Priya Natarajan) — Consulted
- Redwood trial lead (project management / runbook): Lauren Bishop — Responsible
- Redwood infra support (deployment, tuning): Dylan Brooks — Responsible
- Procurement / contract coordination: Sam + procurement@acmehealth.com — Accountable

Next steps (action items)
- Sam/Jordan: confirm owners above and attach any procurement timeline constraints by Fri Aug 1
- Acme security/procurement: complete SOC2 Q&A (attached acme-soc2-qa.xlsx) or tell us if you prefer Redwood to fill initial answers
- Redwood: we will provision a sandbox env and share the POC-template.xlsx and a short runbook by Mon Aug 3
- Lauren/Dylan: prepare onboarding call with your infra/security teams (suggested slot Aug 4)

Attachments: POC-template.xlsx (POC checklist + sample test prompts), redwood-sla.pdf (trial SLAs), acme-soc2-qa.xlsx (blank SOC2 Q&A)

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa
